offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures commercial roofing and waterproofing systems, air and vapor barriers, insulation and weatherproofing products for buildings. Sells mainly to roofing contractors, distributors and building owners. Also makes some engineered products for aerospace and medical customers.

primary_products.value: commercial roofing membranes; polyiso insulation; air and vapor barriers; waterproofing and sealants; coatings

customer_segment.value: B2B: roofing contractors, building product distributors, commercial building owners, architects, aerospace and medical OEMs

end_markets.value: commercial construction; re-roofing and building renovation; residential construction; aerospace; medical

revenue_model.value: product sales: roofing, insulation, waterproofing and weatherproofing products sold via distributors and contractors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures building envelope products from purchased raw materials, sold to distributors and contractors; component supplier: supplies engineered components to aerospace and medical device makers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States and North America, with sales in Europe, Middle East and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: roofing, waterproofing, insulation, coatings and engineered building envelope products

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: roofing and building materials distributors; direct sales: sales to contractors, building owners and OEM customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, energy efficiency standards, environmental and chemical safety rules such as EPA and OSHA

notes: Segment mix and any remaining non-building-envelope businesses are uncertain after recent portfolio changes.
